sources.entry: FinderRight - Open-source Finder extension that adds new file, open in terminal, copy path, and cut & paste to the right-click menu. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/funny-dog/FinderRight) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: FinderRight is a free, open-source macOS Finder extension that adds new-file creation, open-in-terminal, copy path, and cut/paste to the right-click menu.
summary.what_it_does: It adds a right-click menu to Finder for creating files from templates (text, Markdown, Python, JSON, blank Office documents, custom templates). It provides a cut and paste that moves files only on paste, and it offers open in terminal or editor with configurable apps. It copies paths, file names, or file contents in several formats, and can copy SHA-256/SHA-1/MD5 hashes and create symbolic links (both off by default). It also includes image convert and scale actions, optional ZIP compress and extract (off by default), move-to and copy-to favorite folders, undo for the last operation, an operation history log, and an enhanced Quick Look preview extension that renders Markdown and lists archive contents. Cloud-folder and other unsupported locations get the same actions through the right-click Services menu.
use_cases: add new file from right-click in Finder
cut and paste files in macOS Finder
open terminal at current Finder folder
copy file path or file name on Mac
compute SHA-256 or MD5 of a file
batch convert or resize images from Finder
preview Markdown and archives with Quick Look
notable: Cut and paste that moves files only on paste, with a queue viewable in settings
Extended Quick Look previews for folders, archives, SQLite, Jupyter Notebook, CSV and Markdown
Services menu fallback for iCloud, Google Drive and other locations where Finder extension menus don't appear
Single-level undo and a per-day operation history with failure reasons
caveats: Requires macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon; Intel is not supported
Current DMG build is self-signed and not notarized by Apple
Finder extension menus do not appear in cloud drives or unregistered folders such as /Applications; Services menu is used instead
